name: Dominick: Inheritance
source:
Step into the dark world of eleven-year-old Charlie Ewald, where home is a cage, in which he is locked away from the outside world. World, which his cruel father swears, is crawling with nameless terrors. Yet every blow and warning weakens Charlie's faith in those words. When he finally dares to flee, the boy discovers – to his horror – Father wasn't entirely wrong.

[From [url=https://agamichrono.itch.io/dominick-inheritance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
走进十一岁的查理·埃瓦尔德的黑暗世界，家是一个笼子，他被锁在里面与外界隔绝。他残忍的父亲发誓，这个世界正爬满了无名的恐怖。然而，每一次打击和警告都会削弱查理对这些话的信心。当他终于敢于逃跑时，男孩惊恐地发现父亲并非完全错误。

[来自[url=https://agamichrono.itch.io/dominick-inheritance]Itch.io[/url]]
